## UML Testing Profile (UTP) Test Suite for U08_Alarms

**Test Suite Name:** U08_Alarms_TestSuite

**Test Suite Description:** This test suite verifies the functionality of the alarms in the respiratory support system.

**Test Suite Scope:**
- Low pressure alarm
- Pressure high alarm
- PIP too high alarm

**Test Suite Preconditions:**
- The respiratory support system is powered on.
- The patient is connected to the system.

**Test Suite Postconditions:**
- All alarms are in the expected state.

**Test Cases:**

| Test Case ID | Test Case Title | Requirement ID | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Low pressure alarm logs onset and reset | RW-SW-85 | Positive | - | - | 1. Monitor GUI for low pressure alarm log. 2. Manually trigger low pressure. 3. Monitor GUI for alarm reset. | Alarm logs onset and resets automatically. |
| TC-002 | Low pressure alarm triggers with high priority | RW-SW-86 | Positive | - | - | 1. Monitor alarm priority. | Alarm has high priority. |
| TC-003 | Pressure high alarm triggers with 3 consecutive breaths | RW-SW-88 | Positive | - | - | 1. Monitor GUI for pressure high alarm activation. 2. Manually trigger 3 consecutive breaths above threshold. 3. Monitor GUI for alarm deactivation. | Alarm activates after 3 consecutive breaths above threshold and deactivates on first breath above threshold. |
| TC-004 | Pressure high alarm emits sound | RW-SW-89 | Positive | - | - | 1. Monitor sound output. | Alarm emits sound while active. |
| TC-005 | Pressure high alarm remains displayed until cancelled | RW-SW-90 | Positive | - | - | 1. Monitor GUI for pressure high alarm display. 2. Manually cancel alarm. 3. Monitor GUI for alarm disappearance. | Alarm remains displayed until cancelled. |
| TC-006 | Alarm management supports silent alarm state | RW-SW-91 | Positive | - | - | 1. Monitor GUI for silent alarm state. 2. Manually activate alarm. 3. Monitor GUI for audible alarm state. | Alarm can be set to silent state. |
| TC-007 | PIP too high alarm has high priority | RW-SW-93 | Positive | - | - | 1. Monitor alarm priority. | Alarm has high priority. |
| TC-008 | Default PIP too high alarm value is commanded PIP + 5cm H2O | RW-SW-94 | Positive | - | - | 1. Monitor default PIP too high alarm value. | Alarm value is set to commanded PIP + 5cm H2O. |
